plan.title: CAPEX Proposal Requires IP Number and CBA

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly in Master QCS.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed RFQ.
Allocate the available line item to Vendor B as requested.
Verify that the line item and vendor are allocated before creating the proposal.
Open the proposal form after the award allocation.
Verify that the proposal page opened.

args.goal: On the proposal page, choose Procurement Type CAPEX, leave the Investment Proposal (IP) Number and cost benefit analysis fields empty, click Submit Proposal, and stop when the app shows that the submission is refused because the IP number or CBA is required.

steps.note: Exercise the CAPEX-specific validation that no catalog step can directly perform.
